texts.orig: MAINTENANCE CHECKLIST FOR ELECTRIC ROTARY SCREW COMPRESSORS
texts.text: MAINTENANCE CHECKLIST FOR ELECTRIC ROTARY SCREW COMPRESSORS

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Here are some things you can do in between formal preventive maintenance(PM) visits on your electric screw compressor to extend compressor life and prevent downtime. Keeping an eye on these things will give you advance notice if you need service sooner than your next scheduled PM.
texts.text: Here are some things you can do in between formal preventive maintenance(PM) visits on your electric screw compressor to extend compressor life and prevent downtime. Keeping an eye on these things will give you advance notice if you need service sooner than your next scheduled PM.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 1 COMPRESSOR FLU I D LEVEL Most units have sight glasses to check fluid levels. Check level per manufacturer ' s instruction. Top off as needed, but do not overfill.
texts.text: 1 COMPRESSOR FLU I D LEVEL Most units have sight glasses to check fluid levels. Check level per manufacturer ' s instruction. Top off as needed, but do not overfill.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 2 ROOM TEMPERATURE Excess heat increases maintenance frequency. Mount a thermometer in the compressor room. Increase ventilation if room temperature exceeds operating limits.
texts.text: 2 ROOM TEMPERATURE Excess heat increases maintenance frequency. Mount a thermometer in the compressor room. Increase ventilation if room temperature exceeds operating limits.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 3 I NLET F I LTERS Inspect and remove/vacuum loose dust from inlet filters. Frequency depends on ambient dust load.
texts.text: 3 I NLET F I LTERS Inspect and remove/vacuum loose dust from inlet filters. Frequency depends on ambient dust load.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: Inspect and vacuum ambient side of coolers. Frequency depends on ambient dust load. 4 C O O L E R S
texts.text: Inspect and vacuum ambient side of coolers. Frequency depends on ambient dust load. 4 C O O L E R S

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 5 If present, inspect and vacuum. Frequency depends on dust load. COOLER PRE - F I LTERS
texts.text: 5 If present, inspect and vacuum. Frequency depends on dust load. COOLER PRE - F I LTERS

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 6 CHECK BELTS / COUPLERS Inspect belts/couplers for cracks or other signs of wear. Check belt tension monthly and adjust as needed
texts.text: 6 CHECK BELTS / COUPLERS Inspect belts/couplers for cracks or other signs of wear. Check belt tension monthly and adjust as needed

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: GREASE MOTOR BEAR I NGS Failing to keep motors properly greased can lead to motor failures 7
texts.text: GREASE MOTOR BEAR I NGS Failing to keep motors properly greased can lead to motor failures 7

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 8 ELECTR I C CAB I NET Check the cabinet for dirt/dust and moisture. Vacuum dirt/dust. DISCONNECT FROM POWER SOURCE BEFORE OPENING CABINET
texts.text: 8 ELECTR I C CAB I NET Check the cabinet for dirt/dust and moisture. Vacuum dirt/dust. DISCONNECT FROM POWER SOURCE BEFORE OPENING CABINET

texts.label: text
texts.orig: If present, press the test button to confirm proper operation.
texts.text: If present, press the test button to confirm proper operation.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 10 DUTY CYCLE Keep an eye on running hours. Low load % can increase moisture build up in the compressor
texts.text: 10 DUTY CYCLE Keep an eye on running hours. Low load % can increase moisture build up in the compressor
